description:
Implement $q$-cyclotomic coset computation and seed-set closure in gf2-core: given a seed set of root exponents modulo $n$, derive the closed defining set under multiplication by $q$, partitioned into cosets.

## Background

General BCH construction accepts seed sets that are not already closed and derives the closure itself. Coset partitions also drive generator-polynomial assembly (one minimal polynomial per coset) and are a named Lean proof obligation, so the operation lives in gf2-core where the proof surface can reach it.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: gf2-core computes the $q$-cyclotomic closure and coset partition of any seed set modulo $n$ with $\gcd(n,q)=1$, deterministically ordered.
- [hard] REQ-02: Property tests verify closure idempotence, coset disjointness, and agreement between coset unions and closure over binary and nonbinary cases.
title: Implement q-cyclotomic coset closure over extension fields
